title: Cameron Rye Portfolio MCP Server
description: Cameron Rye's blog, projects, resume, and live site stats, plus contact and newsletter tools.
summary: Cameron Rye's blog, projects, resume, and live site stats, plus contact and newsletter tools.
offersHint: Cameron Rye's blog, projects, resume, and live site stats, plus contact and newsletter tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://rye.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_posts
toolsPreview.description: Return up to N most recent published blog posts.

toolsPreview.name: search_posts
toolsPreview.description: Case-insensitive substring match across title, description, and tags. Returns up to 10 matches.

toolsPreview.name: search_site
toolsPreview.description: Semantic (vector similarity) search across blog posts and projects — the same Cloudflare Vectorize retrieval the Ask chatbot uses, without the LLM call. Broader than search_posts (which only does exact substring matching on title/description/tags): finds conceptually related content even when the query words never appear verbatim. Returns scored chunks with deep-link URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_post
toolsPreview.description: Return the full markdown body and frontmatter of a post by slug.

toolsPreview.name: list_projects
toolsPreview.description: Return all portfolio projects with their slug, title, and short description.

toolsPreview.name: get_project
toolsPreview.description: Return the full markdown body and frontmatter of a project by slug.

toolsPreview.name: get_about
toolsPreview.description: Return a short bio about Cameron Rye, the portfolio owner.

toolsPreview.name: get_now
toolsPreview.description: Return what Cameron is currently working on, learning, building, reading, and up to in life — the live /now page sections.

toolsPreview.name: get_reading
toolsPreview.description: Return Cameron's reading list — books currently reading, finished, or abandoned, with notes. Filter by status if given.

toolsPreview.name: get_pulse
toolsPreview.description: Return live, PII-free operational stats for rye.dev: recent Core Web Vitals p75s, 30-day pageviews, trailing-30d uptime %, top-reacted pages, and the last deploy. Same data the homepage pulse strip shows.

toolsPreview.name: submit_contact
toolsPreview.description: Send Cameron a message through the site contact form. Subject to the same validation and per-IP rate limits as the contact form itself.

toolsPreview.name: subscribe_newsletter
toolsPreview.description: Subscribe an email address to the newsletter. Sends a confirmation email; the subscription only becomes active once confirmed. Same validation and per-IP rate limits as the signup form.
